_note: All 80 services below, including fee/processingTime/office, are from the Municipal Government of Aborlan Citizen's Charter 2025 (1st revision), pulled directly from aborlanpalawan.gov.ph's own PDF. Each was individually verified against its own step-by-step 'TOTAL' row (title, office, fee, and time cross-checked together) rather than bulk-parsed, since the document's client-step numbering can look like a service header out of context. Where a service has several sub-processes bundled under one Charter entry, only the primary/first sub-process's figures are used. Purely internal/staff-facing services (procurement, internal budget/accounting postings, HR leave filing, records transmittal) are intentionally excluded — this is a citizen-facing directory. Education has no listed frontline service in the Charter (no formal scholarship program), so it stays empty rather than guessed.

services.title: Birth Registration
services.description: Register a birth with the Municipal Civil Registrar (on-time or delayed registration). This creates the local civil registry record — a certified copy from the national PSA registry is a separate process handled by PSA itself, not the LGU.

services.title: Marriage Registration
services.description: Register a marriage with the Municipal Civil Registrar. A certified copy from the national PSA registry is a separate process handled by PSA itself, not the LGU.
services.processingTime: Same-day for on-time registration; up to 11 days for delayed registration (includes a mandatory 10-day posting period)

services.title: Death Registration
services.description: Register a death with the Municipal Civil Registrar. A certified copy from the national PSA registry is a separate process handled by PSA itself, not the LGU.
